name: Shaon Bernard
original_name: シャオン・ベルナルド
source:
The Protagonist of the story. He is picked up and raised by Pigaro in the sacred mountain. 
Pigaro is a father and mentor. Evita is his stepsister.
Shaon is honest and really values his family
He can also use martial arts based on his master's teaching.
His [b]Tenken[/b] is healing type, but at the start of the story, he gained new power by forming a contract with Minjara.
translation:
The Protagonist of the story. He is picked up and raised by Pigaro in the sacred mountain. 
Pigaro is a father and mentor. Evita is his stepsister.
Shaon is honest and really values his family
He can also use martial arts based on his master's teaching.
His [b]Tenken[/b] is healing type, but at the start of the story, he gained new power by forming a contract with Minjara.
